comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Rank Tech: 4
Consumed Gauge: 120
Range: 100
Scatter Range: 45

It requires two/three seconds before the Tech will be used.
With advanture job this Tech needs only one second till it activates.

Effect:
Aside from damage, your target(s) will be paralyzed for 10 seconds approx. Attacking the enemy while he is paralyzed will shorten the duration. Higher Trap prolongs the "Paralyze" -effect.

I've learned this from Campeche thieves lv39 npc at Gulf of Mexico Southwest coast after he used this Tech against me.

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
After the release with chapter 3 of Atlantis (Acropolis), the conditions for obtaining this tech is now:

Trap rank 7
Entrancing Arrow
